description.en: There are four financial statement tables for every year in the 2013-2018 interval - Rb-27s contains detailed information about revenues, Rb-28s contains expenditures data, Rb-Z contains data about debt and Rb-NDS contains aggregated financial data, like total revenues, total expenditures, change indebt etc.
